explanation: Store credits relative to a global BigInt offset so addAll changes one value. A Map supports lookup and a randomized search tree orders normalized credits with client IDs as tie-breakers. Insert and remove keep both indexes synchronized; max follows the tree’s right edge.
timeComplexity: O(log n) expected insert, remove and max; O(1) expected lookup and addAll for fixed-width credit values.
spaceComplexity: O(n) entries and tree nodes; O(log n) expected recursion stack.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
